gloss: motivation; stimulation; something to strive for

definitions.explanation: The feeling of having something worthwhile to work toward; a sense of purpose or drive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなった。
examples.english: Since retiring, I've lost my sense of purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Having a rival gives me motivation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of purpose in my daily work.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
⟦{張|は}り{合|あ}う→張り合う：16232_hariau⟧ - to compete, to rival

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to have motivation/purpose
- {張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - to lack motivation
- {張|は}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ - to feel a sense of purpose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{励|はげ}み→励み：07282_hagemi⟧ - encouragement, incentive
- やりがい - sense of fulfillment

USAGE:
{張|は}り{合|あ}い often implies motivation from competition or having challenges. Common when discussing life after retirement or the importance of having goals.
